pr_body:
The labels passed in via `--aspect` now go through the main repository's
repository mapping, which ensures that Starlark provider identity is
established correctly even when e.g. the main workspace is referred to
via it's name rather.

Fixes #15989
pr_title: Let labels in --aspect go through repo mapping
pr_comment: @meteorcloudy Could you take a look or should this wait for @Wyverald?

Thanks for the fix! Can you try to add a test in https://cs.opensource.google/bazel/bazel/+/master:src/test/java/com/google/devtools/build/lib/starlark/StarlarkDefinedAspectsTest.java?

@gregestren Can you also take a look?
I don't think I have special insight into this - certainly not the repo mapping part.  What are we looking for in the review?

@meteorcloudy It should also work with the hack - this test case is essentially my original reproducer trimmed down to the essentials. Even if the external repo exists, I think the `RepositoryName` instance will still be different from that of the main repo, meaning that loaded providers will be distinct.

> I think the RepositoryName instance will still be different from that of the main repo, meaning that loaded providers will be distinct.

Oh, got it, thanks!
@sgowroji Can you help merge this, thanks!

review_comment: Hmm, what repo mapping is this label going through? How would this test fail without your change?

I manually verified that it fails without my change.

It goes through the main repository's repo mapping, which AFAIU maps the workspace name `my_repo` to the canonical name, which is just the empty string. Before my change, the label would not go through repo mapping at all, which would cause the `MyInfo` provider to be loaded from the (non-existent) `my_repo` repo and thus differ from the one defined in the main repo.

I see, in a real WORKSPACE, there will be a local_repository called "my_repo" that pointing to the main project's root directory to make that "external repo" available, which is an unfortunate hack, but it seems that's not set up for this test case which makes this test case work. Thanks for the clarifying!
